items.title: jq: pretty-print
items.body:
jq . data.json
curl -s https://api.example.com/items | jq .
items.description: Format JSON from a file or a pipe.

items.title: jq: get a field
items.body:
jq '.user.name' data.json
jq -r '.user.name' data.json
items.description: Nested access and raw (unquoted) output.

items.title: jq: iterate an array
items.body:
jq '.[]' data.json
jq '.items[].id' data.json
items.description: Output each element, or a field of each.

items.title: jq: filter with select
items.body:
jq '.[] | select(.age > 30)' data.json
jq '.[] | select(.name | test("^a"; "i"))' data.json
items.description: Keep only matching elements.

items.title: jq: reshape objects
items.body:
jq '.[] | {id: .id, name: .name}' data.json
jq 'map({id, name})' data.json
items.description: Build new objects from selected fields.

items.title: jq: sort, group, unique
items.body:
jq 'sort_by(.age)' data.json
jq 'group_by(.team) | map({team: .[0].team, n: length})' data.json
jq '[.[].tag] | unique' data.json
items.description: Common array transforms.

items.title: jq: length and keys
items.body:
jq 'length' data.json
jq 'keys' data.json
items.description: Count items and list object keys.

items.title: jq: pass a shell variable
items.body: jq --arg name "{{name}}" '.[] | select(.name == $name)' data.json
items.description: Use --arg instead of string interpolation.

items.title: jq: output CSV
items.body: jq -r '(["id","name"] | @csv), (.[] | [.id, .name] | @csv)' data.json
items.description: Rows as CSV with a header line.

items.title: jq: compact output and slurp
items.body:
jq -c . data.json
jq -s . a.json b.json
items.description: One-line JSON; combine many JSON documents into an array.

items.title: jq: update a value
items.body:
jq '.version = "2.0"' package.json > out.json
jq '.items |= map(select(.active))' data.json
items.description: Modify and write to a new file.

items.title: Validate JSON from the shell
items.body:
jq empty data.json
python3 -m json.tool data.json > /dev/null
items.description: Exit non-zero if the file is not valid JSON.

items.title: yq: read values
items.body:
yq '.services.web.image' docker-compose.yml
yq '.items[].name' file.yaml
items.description: mikefarah yq v4: query YAML like jq.

items.title: yq: edit in place
items.body: yq -i '.spec.replicas = 3' deployment.yaml
items.description: Change a value directly in the file.

items.title: yq: convert between YAML and JSON
items.body:
yq -o=json file.yaml
yq -P file.json            # JSON to pretty YAML
items.description: Format conversion both ways.

items.title: yq: merge two YAML files
items.body: yq eval-all 'select(fileIndex == 0) * select(fileIndex == 1)' base.yaml override.yaml
items.description: Deep-merge, with the second file winning.

items.title: YAML pitfall: unquoted values
items.body:
country: "NO"        # unquoted NO becomes false in some parsers
enabled: "yes"       # unquoted yes/on/off may become booleans
version: "1.10"      # unquoted becomes the number 1.1
zip: "01234"         # unquoted leading zero may read as octal
time: "12:30"        # can parse as sexagesimal in YAML 1.1
items.description: Values YAML 1.1 parsers turn into booleans or numbers; quote them.

items.title: YAML pitfall: indentation and tabs
items.body:
# Tabs are not allowed for indentation: use 2 spaces.
key:
  child: value
message: "error: something failed"   # quote strings containing ': '
path: 'C:\Users\me'                  # single quotes keep backslashes literal
items.description: Only spaces; keep consistent; colons in strings need quotes.

items.title: YAML multi-line strings
items.body:
script: |
  line one
  line two
description: >
  these lines are
  folded into one line
keep_trailing: |+
  keeps trailing newlines
items.description: Literal (|) keeps newlines; folded (>) joins lines.

items.title: YAML anchors and merge keys
items.body:
defaults: &defaults
  restart: always
  logging: json

web:
  <<: *defaults
  image: nginx
items.description: Reuse a block of settings.

items.title: JSON gotchas
items.body:
- Keys and strings need double quotes (no single quotes)
- No trailing commas
- No comments
- No undefined, NaN or Infinity
- Numbers cannot have leading zeros
items.description: What JSON does not allow.
